text: The tree-cover change status for this asset could not be determined. The analysis tool attempted to assess changes using datasets like the University of Maryland’s Global Forest Change and the European Commission’s Global Forest Cover 2020, but it encountered an error. Specifically, the required satellite coverage for this asset hasn’t been processed yet, so no observations were made. As a result, there’s no available data to confirm whether tree cover has increased, decreased, or remained stable since the baseline date of December 31, 2020. Further analysis will be needed once the coverage is prepared.
